name: MSG_QUERY_ACTION
meaning: Wolf only, not floating: 2 (CTX_LIFT) when the box centres are within 90 vertically

name: MSG_PICKUP
meaning: attach to the sender joint arg with offset {10,0,0}; collision off; state 0

name: MSG_DROP
meaning: arg {pos; flags}: flags&2 keep the position; flags&1 -> THROWN and fall, else rest

name: MSG_PUSH
meaning: arg Vec3s* delta: moves with gravity, rolls, writes the moved x/z back, state 2

name: MSG_LANDED
meaning: arg != 0 and THROWN -> shatter (state 4); else StartFall (Catapult/elastic send arg 1 on impact)
